purpose: Audit whether provided-data evidence identifies rule-anchored C2 level/mask corrections, without recreating removed references or tuning to target/leaderboard scores; decide whether a second shrink artifact S2 is justified.

scope.sample_use: GEOID and row order only; sample score placeholders are forbidden.
scope.candidate_budget: Do not create/register/upload a second shrink candidate; if any S2 counterfactual is non-identifiable, preserve one-candidate limit and recommend whether the existing S remains the sole option.

measurement_definitions.C2_component_mass: For each official region and each of transport_gap, building_gap, poi_gap: sum the finite nonnegative frozen C2 component predictions; also report mean, positive-row count, and official n. This is model-output mass, not hidden-reference error or mass against organizer targets.
measurement_definitions.deficit_only_clip: Reproduce the frozen recipe's internal proxy denominators exactly (road=.35+.55*sqrt(ALAND_km2)+.0007*pop_total+2*urban; buildings=max(.5,.30*pop_total+4*sqrt(ALAND_km2)+5*urban); fire=.15+pop_total/30000+.45*urban; EMS=.15+pop_total/40000+.45*urban; schools=.20+pop_total/2500+.20*urban; establishments=.20+pop_total/70+.50*urban). For every type report rows O>=proxy, recipe gap mass on those rows (should be zero due existing clip), and positive C2 mass upper bound. These denominators are the estimator's own domain assumptions, not independent/validated reference counts; actual organizer-reference clip mass remains null.
measurement_definitions.microsoft_building_source: Compute building-record-weighted mean of the provided per-tract Overture Microsoft-source share: sum(overture_buildings * microsoft_source_share) / sum(overture_buildings), over official tracts with valid shares. Also report source-overlap counterfactual mass removed if and only if each source-labeled share were an exact matched reference share, as an unvalidated sensitivity, not an applied correction.
measurement_definitions.poi_establishments: Report provided overture_poi_all count, zero-count coverage, and C2 aggregate POI mass. CBP counts are absent/forbidden; no establishments-half ratio or actual clipped mass may be inferred.
measurement_definitions.poi_facilities: For each provided Overture fire/EMS/school count, report Overture-zero tracts, current recipe-defined status, per-type recipe gap mass on the zero mask, and the changed aggregate POI mass under the explicit stress-test assumption Overture-zero equals USGS-zero. This is an overlap diagnostic only: Overture zero is not USGS zero; true per-type undefined counts and actual dropped mass are null because USGS reference counts are unavailable/forbidden.
measurement_definitions.transport_definedness: Report provided Overture named-road zero support and C2 transport mass. TIGER S1100/S1200 presence is not observed; actual transport undefined rows and corrected mass are null.
measurement_definitions.rule_correction: Only apply a correction in a candidate if the relevant provided-data evidence directly identifies the rule condition; do not treat upstream source provenance, Overture absence, population, density, or a model prior as a validated reference count/mask.
measurement_definitions.facility_stress_test: For each tract, recompute only the POI aggregate if a type is dropped where its Overture selected-category count is zero, using the frozen gap-estimates facility/CBP values and current defined flags. Report this as an assumption-bound counterfactual, never as an estimate of hidden-reference correction.

decision_rule.build_S2: Only if a provided, permitted reference proxy identifies a prespecified level clip or reference-absence mask for the required component(s) and an exact deterministic structural correction can be justified without fitting a coefficient.
decision_rule.do_not_build_S2: If the key denominator/presence evidence is absent, report rule-specific model-mass upper bounds and provided-data proxy overlays, retain the single existing S candidate as the sole shrink option, and state why S2 is not identified.

forbidden: public/private leaderboard scores, scorecards, or algebra on any score
C0/all-zero candidate or its values for choosing any level/factor/rule
removed TIGER, Microsoft US Building Footprints, USGS facilities, CBP layers or any equivalent copy
external datasets or their numerical counts
fitting, target-moment calibration, candidate-registration edits, or uploads

outputs.S2_artifact: none unless the decision rule is met; this preregistration does not authorize a second candidate or upload
